# Notifications

Post-run webhook / digest notification dispatch.

**Tier:** Core

## Modules

| Module | Size | Classes | Functions |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `influx.notifications` | M | 4 | 4 |

## Public API

### `influx.notifications`
- class `HighlightItem` — One ingested item that can appear in digests or article notifications.
- class `IngestedItem` — One ingested item for the ``all_ingested`` array.
- class `RunStats` — Aggregate stats for a single profile run.
- class `ProfileRunResult` — The data a profile run produces, consumed by notification dispatch.
- def `build_digest` — Build the run-digest payload used by ``generic_digest`` sinks.
- def `configured_webhooks` — Return explicit webhook sinks, or a legacy generic-digest fallback.
- def `dispatch_notifications` — Best-effort fan-out of typed notifications for a completed run.
- def `send_digest` — Backward-compatible generic digest sender used by older tests/configs.
